name: Tor Browser
description: The recovered Tor Browser updater inherits MAR verification through compiled primary and secondary certificate data when signature verification is enabled, and rejects a MAR whose embedded channel does not match the configured product channel. This snapshot does not establish a Tor-specific marsigner.der or prove that the accepted certificates differ from stock Firefox's, so the stronger project-specific claim remains unresolved.
limitations: Partial newly retrieved Tor Project checkout with toolkit updater files materialized, not the original study checkout or a built Tor Browser binary.
Generated certificate headers, release channel configuration, and Tor distribution signing assets needed to prove the Tor-specific trust root are absent from this snapshot.
